name: plugin_gait
description: Vicon Plug-in Gait / CGM1 model outputs (also pyCGM2 CGM1.0) mapped to OpenSim LaiUhlrich2022 coordinate names. X/Y/Z are the sagittal/frontal/transverse components stored in the C3D model-output points.
caveat: Sign agreement is not offset agreement: zero positions differ (e.g. Plug-in Gait ankle 0 deg comes from the static-trial foot vector; OpenSim ankle 0 deg is the model's neutral). Use offset-removed statistics alongside raw ones, and confirm signs with a static standing trial before trusting any frontal or transverse comparison. Ask the lab which model they run; CGM2.x, 6DoF and other marker sets need their own mapping file.
